name: sgs/testimonial
title: SGS Testimonial
description: Single testimonial with 7 layout variants — quote, attribution, optional avatar, organisation logo, work media, and a fully optional rating.

quote-box.label: Quote box
quote-box._note_animation: FR-35-6 — the scroll-reveal preset (sgsAnimation/sgsAnimationDuration/sgsAnimationEasing) + staggerDelay resolve via explicit attrMap (no `prefix` declared, per ROLLOUT REQUIREMENT 1). anim:parallax/anim:trigger are honest gaps — no bgParallax/scroll-trigger attrs on this block.

quote-text.label: Quote text
quote-text._note: quoteMarginBottom (render.php:153,241, `'margin-bottom' => $quote_margin_bot`) resolves via the new css:margin-bottom layout member (Spec 35 vocabulary fix). quoteColourGradient (D636 Task 1b) is the text-colour gradient sibling to quoteColour — background-clip:text mechanism; the 'fill' cluster was added solely to place this member.

avatar-image.label: Avatar image
avatar-image._note: Deliberately NOT reachable by the universal image-controls mechanism (design decision, 2026-08-17): style.css:89-95 fixes object-fit:cover + border-radius:50% (circular headshot crop) as a component-owned constant — every avatar needs the same crop treatment, matching the CLAUDE.md DEFAULT-vs-HARDCODE test's 'component's own constant stays' carve-out (same status as sgs/label's fixed fontSize:12). Rendered inside a plain `<div>` (render.php), which the generic mechanism's 3 selectors (`> img` / `.wp-block-image > img` / `figure > img`) never reach anyway — leaving it declared-but-unreached would just be a silent no-op, so it is excluded by design rather than left accidentally dead. Only work-media below is wired for genuine per-instance crop control.

org-logo-image.label: Organisation logo
org-logo-image._note: Deliberately NOT reachable by the universal image-controls mechanism (design decision, 2026-08-17): style.css:101-107 fixes object-fit:contain — a logo must never be cropped, so this is a component-owned constant, not a client-overridable style. Same 'plain `<div>` wrapper, never reached by the generic mechanism anyway' reasoning as avatar-image above.

work-media.label: Work / case-study media
work-media._note: The ONE image slot this block wires for genuine per-instance crop control (design decision, 2026-08-17) — case-study photos vary in composition/aspect ratio, unlike the fixed-crop avatar/logo slots above. `imageControlsExplicit:true` + an explicit `sgs_media_position_css()` call in render.php targets the known selector `.sgs-testimonial__work img, .sgs-testimonial__work video` directly (matches the team-member/gallery/testimonial-slider precedent), rather than relying on the generic render_block guessing injector — which only coincidentally reached this `<figure>`-wrapped slot and never the avatar/logo `<div>`-wrapped ones.

attributes._comment_artDirection: Art-direction tiers (2026-08-07) — the {base}/{base}Tablet/{base}Mobile shape sgs/media and sgs/hero use, object-typed to MATCH avatarMedia (a flat value on an object-typed attr is silently coerced to the default, dropping the whole thing). A tier left empty falls back to the desktop avatar at that width. Deliberately NOT sgs_render_media()'s existing `mobile_url` <picture> path: that is mobile-only, has no tablet step, and is not the BEM tier modifier the cloning pipeline's draft vocabulary reads — one convention on both ends is what makes a clone round-trip.

quoteFontStyle.description: Font style for the quote text. 'italic' or empty for normal.

quoteLineHeight.description: Line height for the quote text. Raw CSS value (e.g. 1.6, 2em). Empty = default.

quoteMarginBottom.description: Space below the quote text. Raw CSS value (e.g. 16px, 1.5rem). Empty = theme default (spacing--30).

borderColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the hover-state border with a masked ::before ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColourHover on hover — this block has no resting-state border colour attribute of its own to override (native __experimentalBorder.color, unaffected).

attributes._comment_wrapperAttrs: WS-4 container-mirror (CONTENT kind): width/spacing only — mirrored verbatim from sgs/container block.json.
attributes._comment_boxTiers: No-inline migration contract §B: tablet/mobile tier overrides for the WP-native style.spacing.padding/margin base (paddingTablet/paddingMobile/marginTablet/marginMobile).

attributes.quote: The quality and reliability of the service has been outstanding from start to finish.
